meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会多出两个工具:先列出本机 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里可用的模型,再把提示发给指定模型并取回回答。它自己仍是调度者,把活分给本地模型跑。
howto.when: 当你要求用 Atomic Chat 或本地模型来回答问题时,或需要让容器内的 agent 调用本机模型时触发。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国首都是哪里
列出 atomic chat 里现在有哪些模型
say.note: 返回可用的模型 ID 列表

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude gains two tools: list the models available in the local Atomic Chat desktop app, and send a prompt to a chosen model to get its reply. Claude stays the orchestrator, offloading work to local models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to answer using Atomic Chat or a local model, or when the container agent needs to call models served by the local Atomic Chat app.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models, then generates a reply

say_en.text: List the models available in atomic chat
Use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: ...
